values.note: $25 a night per camper, $15 a tent (set for 2022; the board kept 2023 fees for 2024). Pay at the self-registration box across from the park house. Seasonal sites $800.

values.note: Electric pedestals carry one 50-amp, two 30-amp and one 20-amp circuit and are shared by up to four campers. Water is stated only for the seasonal sites.

values.note: Opens about two weekends before Memorial Day weekend (May 17 in 2024) and closes in the third week of October in a normal year; weather and flooding can change both (gates shut November 1 in 2024).

season.source: 2021 policies ('will open two weekends before Memorial Day weekend and close the 3rd week of October in a normal year. values.note: Nightly campers take sites 1-24 and 56-59 first-come and register at the box; groups of three or more campers may reserve through the park manager, and stays over four nights need the manager's approval (up to 10 nights in the weekend area).

booking.source: https://lamourecountynd.com/memorial-park ('The camping sites are on a first come, first served basis'); 2021 policies (weekend camping items 2, 4, 6, 10; short-term camping items 2-3), read 2026-11-12

note: LaMoure County park inside a bend of the James River just north of Grand Rapids, on paved roads. Weekend and short-term campers use the sites at the front of the park; about half the park is seasonal sites. Ball field, courts, playground and the county museum in the park; a public 9-hole golf course is a short walk. A feedlot pasture borders the park, and campers have complained of flies and smell. --Claude
summary: County page + 2021 policy + board minutes: FCFS ($25/night camper, 2022 fees kept into 2024), shared 50/30/20-amp pedestals, showers, flush toilets, free dump; ~28 nightly sites (1-24, 56-59) vs 28 seasonal sites (max 32 seasonal campers, wait list ~19). Season ~mid-May to 3rd week of October. Waterfront not waterfront stands (James River ~23 m wide, campers 50+ m back behind a wooded bank). Phone suggestion to the park manager.
